decisions.reason: Requiring a standard JST-PH battery connector does not change the existing overcharge, overdischarge, NTC, or thermal-protection behavior.
The battery connector standard does not affect the SK6812-based charge-status indication path.
Battery connector compatibility does not change ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The battery connector decision does not change the software-switched sensor power rail or its operating pattern.
The candidate already governs battery-connector placement, orientation, access, and clearance; requiring PH for compatibility does not necessarily alter any of those mechanical constraints.
The existing sourceability state concerns USB connector sourcing and alternatives. Calling PH the battery standard does not necessarily modify that sourcing policy or its scope.
The source explicitly identifies the battery as the exception, so the previously selected compact connectors for actual interboard connections remain unchanged.
The battery connector standard has no effect on the native USB D+ and D- data-line requirement.
